symptom: my old script crashes instantly on the new Pi 5 with 'Cannot determine SOC peripheral base address'. It worked fine on the Pi 4.

files.app.py:
import RPi.GPIO as GPIO
GPIO.setmode(GPIO.BCM)
GPIO.setup(17, GPIO.OUT)
GPIO.output(17, GPIO.HIGH)

gold.diagnosis: RPi.GPIO is broken on the Pi 5 (it pokes BCM2835 mmio registers directly; the Pi 5's GPIO is on the RP1 southbridge exposed via /dev/gpiochipN). Only lgpio works on the Pi 5. Rewrite using gpiozero (which auto-selects lgpio) or libgpiod.
